stories.title: «Une situation d’urgence grave» : en Arabie saoudite, au moins 12 morts et 309 blessés à l’aéroport de Ryad dans une attaque imputée aux Houthis

en.title: "A grave emergency situation": At least 12 dead and 309 wounded at Riyadh airport in Saudi Arabia in attack blamed on Houthis
en.summary: A missile struck Riyadh airport in Saudi Arabia, causing at least 12 deaths and 309 injuries in an attack attributed to Houthis. Several wounded individuals are reported to be in critical condition.

stories.title: Donald Trump affirme "qu'il est temps pour l'Ukraine d'avoir un nouveau président" pour parvenir "à un accord" avec la Russie

en.title: Donald Trump states "it is time for Ukraine to have a new president" to reach "an agreement" with Russia
en.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump called for Ukraine to have new leadership to achieve peace with Russia. Trump blamed Volodymyr Zelensky for contributing to global diesel shortages by targeting Russian refineries.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : face à Donald Trump, qui réclame « un nouveau président » à Kiev, le Royaume-Uni assure Volodymyr Zelensky de sa « totale solidarité »

en.title: LIVE, war in Ukraine: Facing Donald Trump, who demands "a new president" in Kyiv, the United Kingdom assures Volodymyr Zelensky of its "total solidarity"
en.summary: Ukraine's foreign minister stated that Ukrainians choose their own leader, while Britain's prime minister expressed solidarity with Kyiv during a difficult period following Trump's call for Ukrainian leadership change.

stories.title: Donald Trump affirme qu’«il est temps pour l’Ukraine d’avoir un nouveau président» pour «parvenir à un accord» de paix avec la Russie

en.title: Donald Trump states that "it is time for Ukraine to have a new president" to "reach an agreement" of peace with Russia
en.summary: Donald Trump called for new Ukrainian leadership to achieve peace with Russia, with a Russian negotiator welcoming his statement. Trump reportedly reached an agreement with Vladimir Putin on diesel and urged Ukraine to stop attacking Russian refineries.

stories.title: Volodymyr Zelensky «mérite d'être soutenu»: les réactions se multiplient après les propos de Trump en faveur d’un nouveau président ukrainien

en.title: Volodymyr Zelensky "deserves to be supported": reactions multiply after Trump's comments in favor of a new Ukrainian president
en.summary: Donald Trump stated from the White House that Ukraine should replace its president to enable a peace agreement with Moscow. Multiple reactions have followed his remarks.

stories.title: 🔴 En direct : Trump s'en prend à Zelensky et dit qu'"il est temps pour l'Ukraine d'avoir un nouveau président"

en.title: 🔴 Live: Trump attacks Zelensky and says "it is time for Ukraine to have a new president"
en.summary: Trump criticized Zelensky and called for Ukraine to elect a new president.

stories.title: Des millions de barils, un effet incertain sur les prix, l'Ukraine en colère... Quatre questions sur l'accord sur le diesel russe entre Donald Trump et Vladimir Poutine

en.title: Millions of barrels, uncertain effect on prices, Ukraine angry... Four questions about the Russian diesel agreement between Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin
en.summary: The U.S. president announced Friday that the United States would purchase Russian diesel for the first time since Ukraine's war began, reversing sanctions against the Russian economy.

stories.title: Arabie saoudite : au moins deux morts dans une attaque au missile contre l’aéroport de Riyad, imputée aux houthistes

en.title: Saudi Arabia: at least two dead in missile attack on Riyadh airport, attributed to Houthis
en.summary: A missile attack struck Riyadh airport resulting in at least two deaths. Traffic was suspended and Western embassies advised staff to avoid the airport for a week following unprecedented attacks on the capital.

stories.title: Paul Seixas remporte le Tour de Lombardie, premier Monument de sa carrière

en.title: Paul Seixas wins the Tour of Lombardy, first Monument of his career
en.summary: At age 20, French cyclist Paul Seixas became the youngest ever winner of the Tour of Lombardy on Saturday in Como, Italy, marking a significant milestone in cycling history.

stories.title: 🔴 Cyclisme : à 20 ans, le Français Paul Seixas devient le plus jeune vainqueur du Tour de Lombardie

en.title: Cycling: at 20 years old, Frenchman Paul Seixas becomes the youngest winner of the Tour of Lombardy
en.summary: Paul Seixas won the Tour of Lombardy at age 20, becoming the youngest victor in the race's history.

stories.title: Après l’accord entre Trump et Poutine sur le gazole, l’Europe entre consternation et soutien réaffirmé à l’Ukraine

en.title: After Trump-Putin agreement on diesel, Europe caught between dismay and reaffirmed support for Ukraine
en.summary: The U.S. president announced Friday that he negotiated massive deliveries of Russian diesel in exchange for lifting sanctions. European responses have been mixed regarding the agreement's implications for Ukraine's war effort.

stories.title: Gazole : Donald Trump s’entend avec Vladimir Poutine pour des livraisons massives russes, Volodymyr Zelensky s’indigne

en.title: Diesel: Donald Trump reaches agreement with Vladimir Putin for massive Russian deliveries, Volodymyr Zelensky expresses outrage
en.summary: Weeks before midterm elections, the Republican president announced importing diesel and lifting sanctions against Russia, moves intended to address price increases affecting Americans and his popularity.

stories.title: L’addition de la crise lycéenne. L'édito de Bruno Jeudy

en.title: The cost of the high school crisis. The editorial by Bruno Jeudy
en.summary: Bruno Jeudy, deputy director of La Tribune Dimanche, presents an editorial on the financial implications of the high school crisis.

stories.title: Arabie saoudite : Riyad de nouveau visé par un tir de missile, au moins deux morts et plusieurs blessés

en.title: Saudi Arabia: Riyadh targeted again by missile strike, at least two dead and several wounded
en.summary: A missile, likely fired by Yemeni Houthis, struck the capital's airport on Saturday, killing at least two people and injuring several others.

stories.title: BAROMÈTRE. Macron au plus bas, Bardella et Le Pen accusent une baisse

en.title: BAROMETER. Macron at lowest point, Bardella and Le Pen also decline
en.summary: A new poll shows Macron's approval falling to historic lows, while Bardella and Le Pen also experience declines. French citizens express alarm about their personal economic situations.

stories.title: Paul Seixas, la réponse monumentale de l'élu en Lombardie

en.title: Paul Seixas, the monumental response from the elected rider in Lombardy
en.summary: The French cyclist dominated the Tour of Lombardy at just 20 years old, claiming his first Monument victory just two weeks after disappointment at the World Championships.

stories.title: Patrick Mennucci en charge de l’organisation de la primaire sociale-démocrate : « Aucun bot n’a pu voter à ce scrutin »

en.title: Patrick Mennucci in charge of organizing the social-democratic primary: "No bots were able to vote in this election"
en.summary: The vote to select the left-wing candidate for the 2027 presidential election faced a cyberattack early in the process, but organizers say the voting results will not be affected.
